description.text: Teaching ObjectiveTo cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurialability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment ofstomatological disease.Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinicalmedicine2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines ofStomatology;3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult,severe symptom;4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills;5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity oforal medical research.Main coursesBiochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medicalfunctional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology,oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine.Degree AwardedBachelor of Medicine

duration.text: The Stomatology at Jinzhou Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. Sponsorship CertificateYou can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports. applicants who have emigrated abroad and acquired foreign nationality must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years or more (before April 30th, 2023), and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during this period (The actual residence in a foreign country for more than 9 months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps).Applicants should be in good health both mentally and physically and without infectious diseases according to The Exit and Entry Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant regulations of JZMU.Applicants with non-criminal records.Applicants with a financial guarantee.Applicants must be holders of a high school diploma or above with good academic records.Applicants should be between 18 and 30 years old.Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have the certificate of HSK level 4; applicants without the certificate of HSK level 4 must pass the Chinese language proficiency test organized by JZMU.
